seams.description: API endpoints interact with JobStore: POST creates a job, GET reads job state, download reads job result
Job worker invokes PdfExportService: worker picks up pending job, calls export_pdf, stores result or error

e2e_gates.scenario: Happy path: POST /reports/r1/export-pdf returns 202 with job_id; poll GET /jobs/{job_id} until status done; GET /jobs/{job_id}/download returns PDF bytes starting with %PDF
Unknown report: POST /reports/nope/export-pdf returns 404 with error field
Invalid language: POST /reports/r1/export-pdf with lang=fr returns 400 with error field
Download before completion: GET /jobs/{job_id}/download while job status is pending returns 409
Job failure: PdfExportService raises exception; job transitions to failed with error string populated; GET /jobs/{job_id} shows status failed
